name: cludegods
description: CludeGods: voice calls, always-on workers, Spaces and a Slack bridge for Claude Code, as desktop mods

plugins.name: workers-pane
plugins.description: The Workers pane: a Welcome view and six worker templates for a two-minute start, a Needs you list of everything waiting on you, a health strip with one-click fixes, and your standing worker chats as god cards with status, an Ask field, hours, activity, and settings in plain words

plugins.name: spaces-pane
plugins.description: The Spaces pane: folders of Markdown pages you and your workers share, with quick page creation, starter Memory rules every worker reads, Ask a worker about a page, and drafts you approve

plugins.name: inbox-relay
plugins.description: Hands messages from the Slack bridge to the right worker chat
